o: 200: the value is cut down to 10
why: Pydantic does not fix the value for you. It stops the request and says which rule failed.

q: A question with only spaces. What happens?
o: 200: the API answers an empty question
why: min_length=1 lets three spaces pass. Your own validator catches what the built-in rule cannot.

q: No question, top_k too big, language not allowed. How many errors come back?
why: Pydantic checks every field and reports all the problems, so the client can fix them in one go.

q: top_k is the word many. What is the type of the error?
why: The type of the error names the kind of problem. Here the text could not be read as a whole number.

q: tag is optional text. The client sends a number. What happens?
o: 422: Input should be a valid string
why: Optional means the field may be missing. It does not mean any type is accepted.
